limits: SELF-REGISTERED, and a weaker member of this register than the other rows. It demonstrates that the harness still tells a crashing gate from a detecting one - the #946 property - because the anchor is a frozen copy of a DIFFERENT program and carries the discrimination. It CANNOT detect a breakage in the harness's own verdict assignment: a harness mutated to emit PASS unconditionally reports PASS about itself. What detects that is tests/test_negative_controls.py, run by pytest in the 'validate' CI step - a different process asserting on exit codes rather than on this harness's judgement of itself. Do not read this row as the harness verifying itself.
